Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Talent Acquisition are strategic members of the HR team who partner with hiring managers to ensure the business recruits the best candidates in the market. You will ensure that we prioritise quality over quantity, and that your approach is personalised and ensures an unparalleled candidate experience.

The type of person who will excel in this role is someone who is process driven, highly communicative, proactive in their work, and has an interest in mobile games.

• Partnering with Hiring Managers and Studio leads, advising on best practices and strategies to ensure we provide an exceptional in-house service.
• Providing an industry-leading candidate and hiring manager experience, ensuring that the business is in a strong position to hire and onboard high-value talent.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
ControlUp is a leader in Digital Employee Experience (DEX), evolving IT operations with agentic AI to deliver Autonomous Endpoint Management (AEM) and a digital workspace that runs itself.

Our platform transforms millions of real-time signals into intelligent action, bridging the gap between deep visibility and automated remediation. We turn "IT headaches" and employee frustration into self-healing operations, allowing organizations to move beyond reactive troubleshooting toward a future where technology works seamlessly in the background.

We’re here to ensure the workday runs without disruptions. No tool sprawl, no wasted time, and no friction. Just technology that works for people, not against them, so they can stay focused on what they do best.

One platform. One powerful shift in how work flows.

About the Role:

We are looking for an HR Business Partner to join our amazing global HR team. The ideal candidate will provide support to our high, mid, and junior-level management, employee relations, and performance management, and be a significant part of the recruitment process. This role will execute different HR strategies focused on talent management, organizational effectiveness, and employee engagement.

What You’ll Own:
• Partner with senior and junior leadership to ensure the HR strategy is structured and functioning to best support our business

• Advise, coach, and guide employees and managers

• Work effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, dynamic environment

• Work closely with executive/mid/junior level managers to align priorities and make sure the recruiting strategies execute well (including negotiation with candidates and contract stage)

• Supporting employee’s lifecycle in the organization from the recruiting process to the onboarding, personal employees’ development, end of employment

What You’ll Bring:
• 2+ years of Human Resources Business Partner experience within a high-tech/technology company

• Experience advising, coaching, and guiding managers and employees

• Ability to work effectively in a global, fast-paced, highly collaborative, dynamic environment

• Hands-on experience in end-to-end recruitment processes, including for R&D positions.

• Ability to influence and advise business leadership

• Strong oral and written communication skills

• Fluent in English both in writing and speaking

• Fun, energetic, and approachable personality.

• Good understanding of the business environment

• Relevant Bachelor’s degree

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Recruiter
jobs.description:
Join UCT and be part of the fastest-growing sector in the world! We indirectly touch every semiconductor chip that goes into every smartphone, smart car and device that uses artificial intelligence. This is a critical time for the semiconductor industry and for UCT - as technology evolves, we evolve with it. UCT is a diverse workplace where every talented employee is committed to continuous innovation, challenging the status quo and exceeding customer expectations. If you are a person with a relentless drive to succeed, a strong focus on quality with a passion for success – join us today!

UCT is looking for a talented Recruiter to join us in Israel!

The Recruiter serves as a consultant to the business, managing full life‑cycle recruitment from sourcing to placement. This role builds strong relationships with hiring managers and stakeholders, develops diverse sourcing strategies, ensures data integrity, and provides regular recruitment updates. By understanding business goals and market trends, the TA Partner delivers qualified candidates efficiently while supporting continuous improvement of talent acquisition practices.

Key Job Responsibilities

• Serve as a TA consultant to the business and build relationships to become a trusted advisor and influencer to the business stakeholders.
• Ensure effective and timely sourcing, selection, and placement of talent with the right character and competence to deliver the organization's goals and objectives.
• Build strong relationships and partner with hiring managers to understand position and candidate qualifications required.
• Responsible for full life-cycle recruitment, from research, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and managing evaluations through offer and acceptance stages.
• Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to consult on hiring plans to meet their staffing needs.
• Understand the business function’s goals, challenges, culture, and career paths to deliver the right candidates most effectively.
• Develop appropriate diverse sourcing strategies, identify suitable candidates for positions, and build diverse pipelines for key talent needs primarily through research, networking, direct recruiting as well as through the use of tools such as LinkedIn, Job Street, and referrals.
• Ensure candidate data integrity in applicant tracking system and throughout the recruitment process.
• Regularly summarize and communicate recruitment updates proactively to hiring managers, human resources, and business leaders
• Stay current on local talent markets including risks, competitors, and compensation trends.
• Effectively execute and support the talent acquisition strategy, processes, and programs
• Actively contribute to continuous improvement of Talent Acquisition practices and participate in various projects as assigned.

Qualifications

• Minimum of 2 to 3 years of sourcing and recruiting experience. Experience recruiting Semicon / Manufacturing workers an advantage.
• Demonstrated intense drive for results and a proactive approach to recruiting.
• Advanced sourcing skills with both active and passive candidates, as well as in-depth knowledge of offer negotiation and closing tactics.
• Results-oriented with demonstrated strategic thinking, innovation, and flexibility in dealing with changing and/or ambiguous situations.
• Must possess a high degree of professionalism and emotional intelligence.
• Demonstrated ability to work proactively and collaboratively within a team setting to accomplish business objectives.
• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
• Proficiency in applicant tracking systems (e.g. UltiPro or similar)
• Demonstrated capacity to communicate effectively and proactively both verbally and written.
• Candidates must have professional proficiency in English, Russian, and Hebrew.

Education

• BA/BS degree or equivalent experience in Business, Human Resources, or related field required.

Caesarea | Full-time | On-site

We are seeking an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner to lead end-to-end recruitment processes across the group.

• Manage full-cycle recruitment processes from intake meeting through offer stage.
• Partner closely with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and define candidate profiles.
• Source and attract talent proactively through LinkedIn Recruiter and additional channels.
• Conduct in-depth interviews, assess candidates, and provide professional recommendations.
• Guide both hiring managers and candidates throughout the recruitment process while ensuring an excellent candidate experience.
• Manage relationships with recruitment agencies and external partners.
• Develop new sourcing channels and talent pipelines for future hiring needs.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
• Strong stakeholder management capabilities and ability to build trusted partnerships with hiring managers.

Apply now or share with someone who might be a great fit!

Join UCT and be part of the fastest-growing sector in the world! We indirectly touch every semiconductor chip that goes into every smartphone, smart car, and device that uses artificial intelligence. This is a critical time for the semiconductor industry and for UCT - as technology evolves, we evolve with it. UCT is looking for a talented Associate, HRBP to join us in Israel!

The Associated HRBP supports managers and employees in achieving business objectives through effective people practices. The role serves as a trusted partner to operational leaders, providing guidance on employee relations, performance management, HR processes, and organizational initiatives while ensuring alignment with company policies and business needs.

• Experience supporting managers and employees in employee relations, performance management, onboarding, and HR policy implementation.
• Working knowledge of labor laws and HR best practices.
• Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Hebrew and English.
• Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to interpret and apply company policies and employment legislation.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and HR systems.
• Strong customer-service orientation and collaborative approach.

שטראוס רואה חשיבות רבה בניהול מדיניות תגמול מתקדמת, אחראית ומבוססת ממשל תאגידי. מנהל.ת תגמול בכירים בשטראוס הוא חלק משמעותי בעיצוב תהליכים המשפיעים על שכבת ההנהלה הבכירה ועל קבלת החלטות ברמה הארגונית הגבוהה ביותר. העשייה בתפקיד מחברת בין אסטרטגיית משאבי אנוש, רגולציה, ממשל תאגידי ועבודה ישירה מול גורמי מפתח בארגון.

jobs.title: Senior HR Manager
jobs.description:
About Unframe

Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.

Backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV Partners with $100M in Series B funding, we’re building a fast-growing, revenue-generating company working with Fortune 500 customers globally.

About The Role

As our first dedicated People Partner in Israel, you’ll own the entire employee lifecycle and play a key role in shaping how we support, develop, and scale our people. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building strong people practices while partnering closely with managers to create high-performing teams.

You’ll be the go-to partner for managers across the organization, helping them navigate performance, employee relations, leadership development, and organizational challenges. You’ll also own the operational side of the employee experience, ensuring every stage of the employee lifecycle is consistent, thoughtful, and aligned with our culture.

What You’ll Do

• Own the end-to-end employee lifecycle for our Israel team, from onboarding through offboarding.
• Work in close partnership with the recruiting team in Israel to accelerate hiring, streamline recruitment processes, and proactively remove obstacles throughout the hiring lifecycle.
• Partner closely with managers on performance management, employee development, promotions, compensation cycles, and day-to-day people decisions.
• Coach managers on leadership best practices, feedback conversations, performance improvement, difficult conversations, and employee relations.
• Design and deliver manager enablement programs and leadership training for both new and experienced managers.
• Lead annual and ongoing performance review processes, ensuring consistency and high-quality execution across the organization.
• Drive employee engagement initiatives and continuously improve the employee experience and build the culture within the office
• Support organizational changes, team effectiveness, and people-related decision making.
• Identify trends and organizational challenges using people data and recommend practical solutions.
• Partner with the global People team to ensure alignment where relevant while tailoring processes for the Israeli organization.

What We’re Looking For

• 6–8+ years of experience in HR, People Partner, or HRBP roles within fast-growing technology startups.
• A hands-on mindset with the ability to move seamlessly between strategic thinking and operational execution.
• Demonstrated experience leading and developing a talent acquisition team.
• Previous experience supporting managers and leadership teams in a high-growth environment.
• Proven experience leading performance management, employee relations, and organizational processes.
• Experience coaching managers through complex people situations with confidence and sound judgment.
• Strong knowledge of Israeli employment law and HR best practices.
• Experience designing and facilitating manager training programs is a significant advantage.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Comfortable working independently and building processes from the ground up.
• Fluent Hebrew and English.

Why Join Us?

Join Unframe at an exciting stage of growth, where you’ll have the opportunity to shape how we build, develop, and support our people. You’ll partner closely with leaders across the company, drive meaningful initiatives, and make a direct impact on our culture, employee experience, and continued growth.

jobs.title: Director, Global Compensation & Benefits

In this role, you will lead the design, governance, and execution of our global compensation, benefits, equity, and rewards programs, ensuring they support business growth, attract and retain top talent, and align with our overall people strategy.
As a member of the Global HR Leadership Team, you will partner closely with senior leaders to influence key business decisions and drive a consistent, competitive, and scalable Total Rewards approach worldwide.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and contribute as a member of the Global HR Leadership Team to shape the company's people strategy.

Qualifications

jobs.title: Industrial Relations Specialist
jobs.description:
The Brink’s Company (NYSE:BCO) is a leading global provider of cash and valuables management, digital retail solutions, and ATM managed services. Our customers include financial institutions, retailers, government agencies, mints, jewelers, and other commercial operations. Our network of operations in 51 countries serves customers in more than 100 countries.

We believe in building partnerships that secure commerce and doing that requires fostering an engaged culture that values people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives. We build a sense of belonging, so all employees feel respected, safe, and valued, and we provide equal opportunity to participate and grow.

We are seeking an accomplished Industrial Relations Specialist to join our team in Israel. In this role, you will play a critical part in managing relationships with trade unions and employee representative bodies across the country. As part of the Human Resources team, this role focuses on collective labour agreement (CLA) negotiation, compliance, and risk mitigation, while also advising leadership on strategic workforce measures that enhance talent attraction and retention within controlled cost frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

Union & Industrial Relations Management

• Act as the primary liaison with recognised trade unions, works councils, and employee representatives.
• Build and maintain constructive, professional relationships to support stable industrial relations.
• Represent the organisation in negotiations and consultations with unions.

Collective Labour Agreement - Negotiation & Administration

• Lead negotiations on collective labour agreements, including pay, benefits, working conditions, and restructuring terms.
• Interpret, implement, and monitor CLAs to ensure compliance with Israeli labour law and organisational policy.
• Advise on implications of union agreements on operational flexibility and cost structures.

Employee & Labour Relations Case Management

• Manage complex employee relations issues, disputes, and grievances in unionised environments.
• Support disciplinary and restructuring processes in line with legal and contractual obligations.
• Provide guidance to line managers on employee relations risk and best practice.

Strategic Workforce & Talent Advisory

• Partner with HR and business leaders to design cost-effective workforce strategies that:
• Attract and retain critical talent
• Align with market competitiveness
• Remain compliant with union and legal frameworks
• Identify opportunities to optimise reward structures within the constraints of CLAs.
• Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement and retention in unionised populations.

Risk, Compliance & Governance

• Ensure full compliance with Israeli employment legislation, union agreements, and internal policies.
• Identify industrial relations risks (e.g. disputes, strike exposure, litigation risk) and develop mitigation strategies.
• Support audits, due diligence, and organisational change initiatives (e.g. M&A, restructuring).

Policy Development & Change Management

• Develop and implement industrial relations policies, procedures, and frameworks.
• Contribute to strategic HR projects impacting unionised employee groups.
• Lead or support consultation processes for organisational change.

Essential

Key Skills & Experience:

• Extensive experience in industrial relations / labour relations in Israel
• Proven track record negotiating collective labour agreements
• Strong knowledge of Israeli labour law and union frameworks
• Experience managing complex employee relations cases
• Commercial awareness with ability to balance cost control and employee outcomes
• Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills
• Fluent Hebrew and English

Desirable

• Experience in multi-site or operational environments (e.g. logistics, security, cash services)
• Exposure to multinational organisations

Key Competencies

• Strategic thinking with strong commercial acum

jobs.title: Human Resources Manager
jobs.description:
Greenberg Traurig (GT), a global law firm with 51 offices worldwide, maintains the largest full-service office of an international law firm in Israel. Our firm currently has a full-time employment opportunity for a Human Resources Manager in our Tel Aviv office. Conveniently located in the Azrieli Center, our Tel Aviv office offers a unique, multicultural, professional home. In addition to stability, competitive compensation and other unique benefits, we offer an opportunity to join a fast-paced and exciting marketing department and engage with various elements of the realm of legal marketing.

Join our Human Resources Team as a HR Manager located in our Tel Aviv office.

Our office is seeking a motivated, creative and passionate Human Resources Manager to join our growing office. In first few months, the Human Resources Manager will be familiarized with the operations relating to Israel, learning the job from the ground-up and working closely with the Business Director and U.S. HR team. The ideal candidate would have 10 years experience in a working environment involving international business, preferably in a law firm environment, an eye for detail, eloquent speaking and writing capabilities in English and Hebrew, be accustomed to working in high paced environment, take directions well, and be socially extroverted. This role offers an excellent opportunity to join a highly-regarded team and to work closely with office leadership.

Position Summary

The Talent Services Manager partners with the Chief Talent Officer, Business Director and Managing Shareholder to provide talent services, professional development and recruiting support to the Firm’s Tel Aviv office in the areas of performance management, training and development, employee relations, policy administration, and other areas within the Talent Services department.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead recruitment, onboarding, and retention efforts for attorneys and staff in the Tel Aviv office, including candidate sourcing, pipeline development, new hire orientation, and attracting top-tier talent in a competitive Israeli market
• Partner with the Chief Talent Officer, Business Director, Managing Shareholder, and local leadership on workforce planning, organizational design, employee engagement, and retention initiatives that support a high-performing and inclusive workplace culture
• Serve as a trusted resource to employees and managers on HR policies, benefits, leave matters, and employee relations, ensuring alignment between firmwide policies and Israeli employment laws, regulations, and local workplace practices
• Advise management on performance management, corrective actions, disciplinary processes, separations, and other complex employee relations matters, including local contingencies such as reserve duty
• Oversee performance management, talent reviews, mentoring, and professional development for associates, staff, and legal support personnel, including manager training, development plans, and coordination with firmwide learning resources
• Support compensation and bonus administration for local support staff by applying sound compensation principles and partnering with management on salary recommendations and related decisions
• Act as the primary HR liaison between the Tel Aviv office and U.S. headquarters, promoting consistency in communication, processes, training requirements, and talent services standards across jurisdictions
• Develop, implement, and continuously improve HR processes, procedures, and recordkeeping practices, maintaining accurate and compliant personnel, recruitment, and separation documentation and recommending policy or process enhancements where appropriate
• Supervise legal support staff to promote high-quality service, efficient workflow, and ongoing development, and assist with additional department activities and responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications

Skills & Competencies

• Ability to establish credibility with staff, attorneys

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition & HR Coordinator
jobs.description:
Factory 54 is a leading global fashion and lifestyle group, headquartered in Tel Aviv and Amsterdam, with operations across Israel and Europe. As part of the Irani Group, we represent and operate more than 150 of the world's leading luxury fashion, footwear, accessories, and beauty brands.
With over 2,000 employees across the group and approximately 450 professionals at our headquarters, nearly all of our core business activities are managed in-house. Our headquarters brings together experts across Technology, R&D, Digital, E-commerce, Marketing, Finance, Human Resources, Buying, Logistics, Operations, Content, PR, Legal, Construction, and more- working collaboratively to drive innovation, business growth, and exceptional customer experiences.
As one of Israel's leading luxury retailers, Factory 54 continues to grow rapidly, combining fashion, technology, and innovation in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where people make the difference.
Join Our Team
We're looking for a Talent Acquisition & HR Coordinator to join our Recruitment & HR team.
In this role, you'll partner with hiring managers across the organization, lead end-to-end recruitment for a wide variety of corporate positions, and help shape the teams that drive Factory 54's continued growth.
If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy building meaningful relationships, and are passionate about connecting exceptional talent with exciting career opportunities, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
• Manage full-cycle (end-to-end) recruitment, from role briefing and sourcing through offer stage and onboarding.
• Partner closely with hiring managers, providing strategic recruitment guidance and ensuring hiring plans align with business needs.
• Source and attract top talent through multiple recruitment channels, including LinkedIn Recruiter, proactive sourcing, job boards, and talent pipelines.
• Conduct phone and in-person interviews, assess candidates, coordinate hiring processes, and support offer negotiations.
• Deliver an outstanding candidate experience that reflects Factory 54's employer brand and company culture.
• Maintain recruitment data within ATS platforms, monitor hiring metrics, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
• Participate in and lead cross-functional recruitment, employer branding, and HR initiatives.
• Support employee experience and engagement projects that strengthen our workplace culture.

Requirements
• +2 years of experience managing end-to-end recruitment processes.
• Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, sourcing tools, and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).
• Ability to manage multiple recruitment processes simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong interviewing, assessment, and stakeholder management skills.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication abilities with a service-oriented mindset.
• Proactive, business-oriented approach with the ability to work independently and drive recruitment initiatives.
• Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to influence hiring managers and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Passion for talent acquisition and a strong motivation to grow within a leading and rapidly evolving organization.

Why Join Factory 54?
At Factory 54, recruitment is much more than filling positions- it's a strategic driver of our company's growth and success.
Joining our team means you'll have the opportunity to partner with inspiring leaders, recruit across diverse business functions, contribute to impactful HR and Employer Branding projects, and grow your career in an innovative, fast-paced, and collaborative environment.

We help organizations unlock the full value of voice, transforming every conversation into a strategic asset that drives smarter decisions, better experiences and business growth. Our portfolio spans secure voice infrastructure, unified communications and contact center, with next-generation AI-powered voice solutions. With over 30 years of expertise and presence in more than 100 countries, AudioCodes is trusted by 65 of the Fortune 100 to power intelligent, agile and future-ready interactions across businesses worldwide.

This role owns the Voca CIC training function end-to-end, from strategy and curriculum design through lab development, live delivery, and continuous improvement. You will be the go-to expert for enablement across internal teams, channel partners, and enterprise customers globally, working cross-functionally with Product, R&D, and Sales to keep training aligned with the product and the market. If you want to be the person who makes sure every partner, customer, and teammate truly understands how to unlock the power of Voca CIC. This is where it happens.

About The Product

Voca CIC is AudioCodes’ flagship, award-winning Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) portfolio, designed to meet organizations where they are today and where they’re going next. The portfolio covers two distinct opportunities: a Microsoft Teams-native contact center for organizations standardized on the Microsoft ecosystem, and a voice-platform-agnostic AI Receptionist that runs on top of any phone system.

Voca CIC for Microsoft Teams is an AI-first, full omnichannel contact center, Microsoft Teams Unify certified and built natively in Azure on the same voice backbone that powers Microsoft Teams Phone. That delivers the tightest integration model on the market. Where other vendors “plug into” Teams through loose connectors, Voca CIC lives inside Teams, so every Teams user can play a role in the service workflow.

It is AI-first by design, embedding Conversational AI and Generative AI into the agent and customer journey through AI voice agents, AI call summarization, and sentiment analysis, alongside an omnichannel toolkit that unifies voice, chat, and email into a single agent screen. Voca CIC has won three major industry awards in two years (CX Today Best Microsoft Teams Contact Center 2024, CX Today Best CX Deployment 2025, and UC Today Best Microsoft Teams Contact Center 2025), with more than 200 enterprise customers in production across 12+ Microsoft Azure regions worldwide.

The Voca AI Receptionist is our standalone, entry-level AI offering for businesses of all sizes, from SMB to large enterprise. Built as a multi-platform solution that sits on top of any voice platform (Microsoft Teams, Cisco, Avaya, RingCentral, traditional PBX, or carrier voice services), it dramatically expands our addressable market well beyond the Microsoft footprint. It delivers AI-driven call routing, document and website-grounded Q&A, CRM integration, appointment scheduling, and outbound SMS to organizations looking for a fast on-ramp into AI-powered customer service, regardless of the phone system they already own.

• הדרכת מנהלים בנושאי משוב, פיתוח עובדים, ניהול צוותים ושיפור אפקטיביות ארגונית.

*חוויית עובד ותרבות ארגונית*

• בניית תוכנית עבודה שנתית בהתאם לאסטרטגיית אגף משאבי אנוש והוצאתה לפועל.
• הובלת יוזמות להגברת מעורבות העובדים ולחיזוק התרבות הארגונית.
• ייזום והובלת פעילויות ותהליכים חוצי ארגון בתחומי חוויית העובד.

*תקשורת פנים ארגונית ומיתוג מעסיק*
• הובלת תחום התקשורת הפנים ארגונית.
• בניית אסטרטגיית תקשורת פנים ארגונית ויישומה.

• ניסיון ביצירת תוכן פנים ארגוני וחיצוני – יתרון.

כישורים אישיים

• יכולת לעבור מחשיבה אסטרטגית לתכנון ולביצוע בפועל.

**שלב חובה בתהליך הגשת המועמדות – סרטון היכרות**
כחלק מתהליך הסינון הראשוני, יש להשלים סרטון קצר באורך של עד שתי דקות באמצעות הלינק המצורף.

jobs.title: Recruitment Specialist
jobs.description:
Innodata Israel, located in Jerusalem, is seeking a Recruitment Specialist to join our growing Israel facility. We are looking for a candidate with proven recruitment experience, available for a full-time position. This is a full-time remote position that requires periodic presence at the Jerusalem office.

This role reports to the global Talent Acquisition team and involves close collaboration with hiring managers and stakeholders across Israel and Europe.

We are looking for a curious, adaptable, and self-driven recruiter who enjoys learning new domains, navigating changing hiring needs, and recruiting across different geographies, markets, and role types.

Key Responsibilities
•Screen, review, and organize incoming CVs, ensuring accurate filing and timely progression through the recruitment pipeline.
•Manage the full recruitment cycle – from sourcing and initial screening through interviews, coordination, offer stage, and onboarding documentation.
• Recruit for a diverse range of roles across Israel and Europe, including technical and non-technical positions, full-time employees, contractors, and freelance talent.
• Adapt recruitment strategies to different markets, business needs, and hiring models while proactively learning new domains and talent landscapes.
•Maintain ongoing communication with hiring managers, providing updates, aligning on requirements, and ensuring recruitment targets and timelines are consistently met.
•Support a smooth and positive candidate experience, including scheduling interviews, managing candidate assessments, and facilitating seamless onboarding processes.
•Track and update recruitment data in internal systems to ensure accuracy, compliance, and effective reporting.
• Assist with general HR administrative tasks, including document management, reporting,internal communications, and supporting HR projects as needed.

Requirements:
• Proven experience recruiting for European markets – Must
• Minimum of 2 years of experience in a full-cycle recruitment role- Must
• Fluent in English and Hebrew
• Experience with crowd staffing
• Strong adaptability and ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with evolving hiring needs and priorities
• Self-driven learner with a research-oriented mindset, capable of independently gaining expertise in unfamiliar domains and translating that knowledge into effective hiring strategies
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office
• Experience with AI tools – an advantage
• Bachelor’s Degree – preferred

About us: With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, Innodata is the AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 7 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, law, and medicine. We’re at an exciting stage in the company and fortunate in these times to grow our team.

We’re an equal opportunity employer.
Only relevant applicants will be contacted

jobs.title: Human Resources Generalist (Part-time)
jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As an HR Generalist you will be responsible for a variety of Human Resources tasks or programs, including advising people managers on the execution of performance management, coaching, corrective action issues, team building, employee development and compliance programs. You will provide primary operational (daily) support for our managers and employees. We ask that you have team participation and interfaces within all areas of Human Resources to provide support for managers and employees. The HRG will also help expand the HR presence throughout the organization and also supporting culture shifts through targeted programs.

You will report to the HR Manager Italy & Israel and have a hybrid and part time schedule working in Israel (Netanja or Holon).

Your Responsibilities

• Partner with HRBPs, CoEs leaders at a local level to bring value and support to the business through: execution of performance management, coaching, corrective action issues, team building, employee development, compliance programs, execution of university relations programs/activities.
• Provide feedback to HRBPs, COEs and HR Services to assist those functions to deliver continuous improvement and consistency to all employees.
• Local deployment support of HR programs (ex. Implementing new payroll methods locally, SAP implementation, launching new CoE program, others).
• Deliver HR training activities provided by the COEs or HR Services to managers and employees.
• Partner with HRBP and Legal on execution employee investigations.
• Provide regional benefits support when needed.
• Provide support for local languages and data gathering when site specific identified.
• Require data for local activities when needed: tax audit, investigation, invoice data entry, legal review, EHS, compensation guidance, represent company in employee dispute.
• Manage, with input from hiring manager, all voluntary terminations, reductions in force. This includes planning, costing, and documenting all stages of the exit (with the support from HRBPs).
• Ensure, when site specific, all local policies and procedures are up to date along with any transition needed according to local legal requirements.
• Provide guidance to local managers on performance management to prevent employee disputes.
• Provide support for on-site audit/compliance reviews (regulatory/legal requirements). Comply with local laws related to ensuring a positive, non-discriminatory and safe work environment. These changes may include reviewing policies, procedures, handbooks and employment documents.
• Provide support for any company-wide changes or programs, such as employee development, restructuring, support HRBPs with organizational design and change management efforts.
• Provide local support for corporate programs, such as engagement and inclusion programs, global voices (employee survey) and action planning.

The Essentials - You Will Have

• Minimum 3 years' human resources experience, including direct, hands-on experience managing employment issues.
• Solid knowledge of local labor law.
• Experience working in diverse lines within a global matrix organization.
• Very good command of English (written and spoken) and local language.
• Bachelor's Degree within Human Resources, Business, or related.

The Preferred - You

Description

Paragon is a fast-growing Tel Aviv based cyber intelligence company, that is rapidly establishing itself as a key player in the industry. We are an innovative company with a cutting-edge product.

We are looking for a highly skilled Training Specialist to join our team!

This role combines instructional design with presentation delivery and is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable writing documentation as they are leading a session.As a Training Specialist you will be responsible for curating training materials by working closely with Product and Marketing Managers to translate complex product features into clear accessible learning content. In addition, you will serve as an instructor and deliver the curated material in engaging face-to-face or remote sessions to customers and colleges from other teams.

Responsibilities

Content Development

• Collaborate with Product Managers, technical experts and other stakeholders to understand new product features and workflows
• Curate training content including user guides, presentations, step-by-step tutorials and supporting documentation
• Maintain and update content to reflect the ongoing product development
• Ensure consistency, clarity, and high linguistic quality in all materials
• Participate in the design of the Company’s learning strategy

Instruction & Delivery

• Lead training sessions (remote or on-site) for clients and Company colleges
• Present complex information in a clear, engaging, and digestible format
• Adjust training approach based on the audience’s needs and feedback
• Maintain and manage the training environment and products

Program Management

• Design structured training programs (e.g., onboarding, certifications, role-based learning tracks)
• Track participation, gather feedback, and analyse training effectiveness
• Suggest and implement improvements to training processes and tools

Requirements

• 3+ years experience of hands-on face-to-face and remote training instruction, with proven experience standing and delivering content in front of an audience - a must
• Native-level written English with strong grammar skills – a must
• Native or fluent spoken English- a must
• Ability to translate complex technical topics into easy-to-understand language
• Proficiency in PowerPoint, Word, Google Slides, and LMS platforms.
• A proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop others is an advantage
• Experience working with Product or R&D teams – a plus
• Ability to work independently and as a part of a team
• Excellent time management skills
• Attentive to detail, self-learner, motivated, flexible, and proactive
• Willingness to travel extensively - up to 50% travel

Today, more people than ever are speaking publicly about their mental health. Whether it's ourselves, our friends and family or even public figures, taking care of your behavioral health is no longer a taboo, it's vital, and it's only human.

Eleos is on a mission to help deliver the world's most effective behavioral care through data, measurement, and personalization. Or simply put, we want to give clinicians the support they need to do the important work only they can do.

This role sits at the heart of our HR operations - owning the day-to-day employee’s employment life cycle, from onboarding through offboarding, while helping connect our local processes with global People Operations standards.

You'll be part of the IL People Team and work closely with our global People Ops team to align local practices with company-wide processes, and make sure that what we do here in Israel is consistent with how things work across the organization - while also reflecting local needs and requirements.

What You’ll Do

Employee Lifecycle Management

• Manage onboarding and offboarding processes
• Handle employment changes such as promotions, transfers, and role or salary updates
• Maintain employee files and employment documentation
• Manage vacation, leave of absence, and parental leave processes

HR Data, Systems & Global Alignment

• Own and maintain our HRIS systems
• Manage user permissions and access within HR systems
• Prepare and issue HR documents
• Work cross-functionally with teams like Finance on topics such as payroll, insurance, and benefits
• Liaise with external vendors, including insurance providers
• Support the implementation of global People Operations processes locally, helping bridge between global standards and local practice
• Generate reports and analyze HR data

Process Improvement

• Monitor and maintain HR policies and procedures
• Identify opportunities for automation and process efficiency
• Involvement in cross-organizational projects within People Operations

Who You Are

• 2-3 years of experience in HR Operations / People Operations from Tech Company
• Experience working with HRIS systems
• Strong proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets
• Strong data analysis and reporting skills
• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks at once
• High level of English
• Ability to work across multiple stakeholders and interfaces
• Strong organizational skills, excellent interpersonal abilities, strong communication skills, team player, and a high sense of ownership and responsibility

About HUMAN Security

HUMAN was founded in a Brooklyn sci-fi bookstore with a hacker mindset and the lofty mission of making the internet safer by putting humans first. Today, our Human Defense Platform safeguards enterprises from sophisticated bots, fraud, and account abuse, verifying the humanity of more than 20 trillion interactions per week for the world’s biggest brands and internet platforms.

HUMAN is an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to protecting the internet's integrity for everyone. We believe in putting people first, embracing diversity of thought from our global teams, and welcoming all individuals to share their unique experiences as we fight cybercrime together. We support our Humans with a comprehensive total rewards package for personal and professional development, including well-being and learning stipends, flexible work options, and dedicated time off. While our HQ is in NYC, we have teams worldwide.

The HR Partner role in our Builder Experience Team (BeXT) is focusing on the Builder experience. You can expect to do the following in your day-to-day:

• Influence change and foster an environment of inclusion for our Builders

In this role, you will collaborate with AWS business leaders and other HR teams to innovate, implement, and deploy HR strategies from talent and performance management, compensation, employee relations and other HR functions. jobs.title: Technical Recruiter (6 months Contract)
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

We are looking for a Technical Recruiter (6-Month Contract) to come in and help recruit and scale our R&D and Product teams in Tel Aviv. We're looking for someone who is comfortable with efficient, high-volume recruiting. You will play a key role in partnering across the business, globally, on the best hiring, interviewing, and closing strategies. You will exact high recruiting standards with a focus on candidate experience at all stages of the recruiting cycle. You will be a key member of the TA team focused on hiring top technical talent into the company while also managing recruiting-related projects.

The ideal candidate is process-driven, detail-oriented, and eager to take on the challenge of helping us rapidly grow our company. You are comfortable with ambiguity and can pivot with a smile on your face. You are happy to help out with recruiting-related initiatives and projects. You are committed to an excellent candidate experience and constantly looking at ways to improve the recruitment process for the recruiting team, candidates, and hiring panel. You enjoy sourcing and love the thrill of finding passive strong talent.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Manage full-cycle recruiting process: identify, engage, and evaluate top candidates.
• Source and maintain a diverse pipeline of passive candidates across tech sectors (cloud, security, data, and analytics).
• Be a thought partner to executives and stakeholders in Tel Aviv, the US, and Prague to develop strategies, make critical decisions, and drive creative approaches for recruiting top talent.
• Act as an advocate for both hiring managers and candidates; establish regular touchpoints and maintain thorough follow-through.
• Participate in recruiting projects and initiatives to improve current processes during this 6-month period.
• Utilize existing tools to source and discover creative ways to engage candidates.
• Work closely with interview teams to create an exceptional candidate interview process and experience.

What skills and experience should you bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• Around 4-7 years of experience in recruiting, with a strong focus on technical and tech-industry hiring.
• Comfortable with ambiguity and a high sense of urgency in a very dynamic environment.
• Excellent sourcing skills and

jobs.title: Senior Total Rewards Analyst
jobs.description:
Medison is a distinctive global pharmaceutical company driven by an unwavering purpose: to deliver groundbreaking therapies to patients suffering from rare and severe illnesses in international markets (excluding the US, Western Europe, and Japan).

Positioned at the forefront, Medison pioneers the category of global partnerships. Our collaborative efforts with emerging biotech enterprises harness the power of our unparalleled global platform. Our ultimate mission is patient-centric: to expedite access to remarkably innovative treatments for those in need.

Operating across over 30 countries spanning 4 continents, Medison embodies dynamism, rapid growth, and global presence. We seek individuals who resonate with our fervor and principles, individuals eager to unite in our mission to champion the rights of patients in distress.

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Total Rewards Analyst who is detail-oriented, while able to draw insights and see the big picture. This role will take part in the global design, development, and execution of our total rewards programs. This role calls for close collaboration with HR Business Partners and business leaders to deliver data-driven insights that support equitable and competitive rewards practices.

Responsibilities:

• Conduct comprehensive global salary and benefits benchmarking using external market data and internal analytics.
• Support annual compensation review cycles, including data validation, modelling, and distribution of compensation guidelines.
• Develop and maintain dashboards and reports related to compensation, benefits, and workforce analytics.
• Manage and monitor the global career architecture, global salary structures, and pay policies across all levels and geographies.
• Support the annual compensation review cycle, including base salary, short-term incentives, and long-term incentive (LTI) planning, calculation, communication, and payment.
• Support benefit programs and policies including health, retirement, wellbeing, and perquisites, to ensure they are consistently applied, cost-effective, compliant, and valued by employees.
• Follow up and monitor global and local regulations as well as data integrity in HR systems.
• Participate in the rollout and continuous improvement of global total rewards initiatives and programs.
• Work closely with HR, finance, IT, legal teams as well as other internal stakeholders.

Requirements:

• 5+ years of experience in total rewards or compensation & benefits, preferably from global companies.
• Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences industry is preferred.
• Experience working with senior management is a preferred.
• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
• Strong collaboration skills and team-oriented.
• Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance or related field, with MBA or Master’s degree in a relevant field a plus.

jobs.title: Global HR Operations & HRIS Manager
jobs.description:
Welcome to the future of cloud networking and security!

Cato Networks is the first company to converge enterprise networking and security into one centralized and global service that is delivered by cloud. It is led by networking and security pioneer Shlomo Kramer (Check Point, Imperva) and early investor (Palo Alto Networks, Exabeam, Trusteer and more). Cato’s unique technology inspired a brand-new product category, later named “SASE” by Gartner and a market expected to reach $28.5 billion by 2028.

This is your opportunity to get on the rocket ship and join a company that is building a cutting-edge enterprise network and secure cloud platform, and is on a fast track to becoming the worldwide market leader – don’t miss it!

We operate at consumer scale, protecting millions of people every day across devices, accounts, and digital touchpoints. In a world where phishing, fraud, and AI-powered scams evolve overnight, Guardio stays ahead of the curve.

If you believe that great HR is built on clean data, tight processes, and systems that actually work - and that when those things are in place, everything moves faster, this is the place for you.

Mize is a Fintech-travel start-up that uses high-end technology to solve some of the huge challenges of the evolving travel industry and provide real financial value to our network of clients, including more than 200 international clients generating $16 Billion in sales annually. Our headquarters are in Tel Aviv, and we have offices in Argentina, Spain, UK, US, and India. Each member of our team is an all-around player that influences the product from overall experience to development, and you'll be no different.

We are looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our people team for a maternity leave cover. In this role, you will play a meaningful part in shaping our global people strategy by managing the full recruiting lifecycle across our international teams. This is a hands-on, end-to-end recruitment role within a fast-paced, scale-up environment where your work will have real and immediate impact.

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening through to offer negotiation and closing.
• Identify and implement effective recruiting strategies tailored to each role and market.
• Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline using both traditional and non-traditional sourcing channels.
• Ensure a top-notch candidate experience by maintaining clear, timely, and professional communication throughout the process.
• Partner closely with hiring managers to deeply understand their needs and align hiring strategies with business goals.

Requirements:

• 2+ years of experience in global talent acquisition or recruitment, within a tech or scale-up environment.
• Proven ability to manage multiple open roles simultaneously across different functions and geographies.
• Strong sourcing skills — experienced with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and creative outreach methods.
• Experience working with an ATS and other recruitment tools.
• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
• A genuine passion for recruitment and a commitment to delivering an exceptional candidate experience
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description:
Appcharge is a leading direct-to-consumer platform for app publishers.

We help publishers sell digital goods directly to their users - bypassing traditional app store commissions and owning the full payment and commerce experience.

The result: higher margins, better flexibility, and a more direct relationship with end users.

Backed by $89M from leading investors and operators, we’ve grown 14x in the past year and now process over half a billion dollars annually. We’re building the infrastructure that lets modern app businesses take back control of monetization – at scale.

As a Talent Acquisition partner, you will be responsible for managing the full recruitment lifecycle for technical roles, partnering closely with hiring managers, and driving high-quality hiring processes end-to-end.

Responsibilities

• Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for various roles, from sourcing to offer stage
• Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and hiring strategies
• Proactively source and attract top technical talent through various channels
• Conduct screening interviews and guide candidates through the hiring process
• Ensure an excellent candidate experience throughout the process
• Track and analyze recruitment metrics to continuously improve hiring performance

Requirements

• At least 4 years of experience in end-to-end recruitment
• Proven experience recruiting for R&D / technical roles / global roles from startup companies
• Experience conducting HR interviews and extending offers to candidates
• Strong sourcing and stakeholder management skills
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Fluent in English (written & verbal)

jobs.title: Wellbeing & Employer Branding Specialist (Maternity Leave Cover)
jobs.description:
Back to careers

Description

About the Unit:

Ceva is the leader in innovative silicon and software IP solutions that enable smart edge products to connect, sense, and infer data more reliably and efficiently. HR department supports employees in all aspects related to their work.

About The Role

We are looking for a maternity leave replacement to join Ceva’s HR team in a diverse, dynamic, and meaningful role.

The position is responsible for employee experience, wellbeing, internal communications, employer branding, and support for cross-organizational projects, while working closely with internal stakeholders and external vendors.

Responsibilities

Manage and execute employee wellbeing and employee experience activities throughout the year, including company events, holidays, gifts, team-building activities, community and volunteering initiatives, and internal engagement programs.

Write, edit, and distribute internal communications for employees, including emails, newsletters, invitations, posts, content for digital screens, and internal communication channels.

Support Employer Branding activities, including content creation, campaign support, recruitment-related activities, and communication with global stakeholders.

Plan and deliver projects end-to-end — from concept and idea, through timeline building, budget management, and vendor coordination, to execution and post-activity wrap-up.

Manage ongoing work with vendors, including obtaining quotations, negotiating, logistical coordination, execution follow-up, purchase orders, and payments.

Work closely with multiple stakeholders across the organization, including HR, Operations, IT, Facilities, Finance, Marketing, managers, and employees in Israel and abroad.

Support internal initiatives related to employee engagement, sense of belonging, organizational culture, wellbeing, and communication across teams.

Requirements

• At least 5 years of experience in wellbeing, employee experience, HR, internal communications, employer branding, or organizational event production roles.
• Proven experience managing projects end-to-end, including planning, coordination, vendor management, timeline management, and budget management.
• Excellent written communication skills in Hebrew and English.
• Experience working with multiple stakeholders across the organization, including managers, employees, vendors, and global teams.
• Strong ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, with excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to meet deadlines.
• Service-oriented approach, excellent interpersonal communication skills, independence, initiative, and accountability.
• Ability to drive processes, solve problems in real time, and work in a dynamic and changing environment.

Advantages

• Experience working with Canva, PowerPoint, and tools for content creation and internal communications — an advantage.
• Experience in a global organization and/or high-tech company — a significant advantage.

jobs.title: Global Talent Acquisition Specialist (Maternity Leave Cover)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Global Talent Acquisition Specialist, who will play a key role in supporting recruitment processes of senior leadership and executive-level talent across multiple regions. You will help drive a seamless and high-touch recruitment experience by coordinating complex hiring processes, managing executive search activities, and partnering with stakeholders globally to ensure exceptional candidate and hiring manager experiences.

Main Responsibilities:
• Coordinate executive search processes, driving candidate progression, stakeholder alignment, and timely hiring outcomes.
• Handle end-to-end recruitment activities for senior roles hires across global markets, ensuring an exceptional candidate and stakeholder experience.
• Hands-on sourcing for top executive talent, leveraging multiple channels, networks, and proactive search to identify high-potential candidates.
• Maintain and manage the Applicant Tracking System (ATS), ensuring accurate candidate records, interview feedback, hiring documentation, and reporting.
• Monitor recruitment workflows and ensure compliance with internal processes and data integrity standards.
• Coordinate complex interview schedules involving senior executives, leadership teams, and external candidates across multiple time zones.
• Partner closely with hiring leaders, HR Business Partners, and external search partners to ensure smooth execution of recruitment activities.
• Act as a primary point of contact for executive candidates throughout the recruitment process, delivering professional, confidential, and personalized experience.
• Maintain regular communication with candidates, providing updates, managing expectations.
• Support Global Talent Acquisition initiatives related to employer branding, executive hiring practices, recruitment analytics, process optimization, and technology adoption.
• Contribute to projects aimed at elevating the overall effectiveness of Global HR Processes.

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field.
• Minimum 5 years of proven talent acquisition experience, with a successful track record of placements across multiple geographies.
• Hands-on experience with applicant tracking systems (ATS) and LinkedIn Recruiter.
• Knowledge of interviewing & sourcing techniques.
• Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with advanced English proficiency (C1 level) required.
• Attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
• Ability to collaborate and work effectively in a global and cross-functional team environment.
• Willingness and flexibility to accommodate working hours across multiple global time zones as need.

IMPORTANT NOTE: Please, kindly submit your CV in English.

jobs.title: Human Resources Manager
jobs.description:
Greenberg Traurig (GT), a global law firm with 51 offices worldwide, maintains the largest full-service office of an international law firm in Israel. Our firm currently has a full-time employment opportunity for a Human Resources Manager in our Tel Aviv office. Conveniently located in the Azrieli Center, our Tel Aviv office offers a unique, multicultural, professional home. In addition to stability, competitive compensation and other unique benefits, we offer an opportunity to join a fast-paced and exciting marketing department and engage with various elements of the realm of legal marketing.

Join our Human Resources Team as a HR Manager located in our Tel Aviv office.

Our office is seeking a motivated, creative and passionate Human Resources Manager to join our growing office. In first few months, the Human Resources Manager will be familiarized with the operations relating to Israel, learning the job from the ground-up and working closely with the Business Director and U.S. HR team. The ideal candidate would have 10 years experience in a working environment involving international business, preferably in a law firm environment, an eye for detail, eloquent speaking and writing capabilities in English and Hebrew, be accustomed to working in high paced environment, take directions well, and be socially extroverted. This role offers an excellent opportunity to join a highly-regarded team and to work closely with office leadership.

Position Summary

The Talent Services Manager partners with the Chief Talent Officer, Business Director and Managing Shareholder to provide talent services, professional development and recruiting support to the Firm’s Tel Aviv office in the areas of performance management, training and development, employee relations, policy administration, and other areas within the Talent Services department.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead recruitment, onboarding, and retention efforts for attorneys and staff in the Tel Aviv office, including candidate sourcing, pipeline development, new hire orientation, and attracting top-tier talent in a competitive Israeli market
• Partner with the Chief Talent Officer, Business Director, Managing Shareholder, and local leadership on workforce planning, organizational design, employee engagement, and retention initiatives that support a high-performing and inclusive workplace culture
• Serve as a trusted resource to employees and managers on HR policies, benefits, leave matters, and employee relations, ensuring alignment between firmwide policies and Israeli employment laws, regulations, and local workplace practices
• Advise management on performance management, corrective actions, disciplinary processes, separations, and other complex employee relations matters, including local contingencies such as reserve duty
• Oversee performance management, talent reviews, mentoring, and professional development for associates, staff, and legal support personnel, including manager training, development plans, and coordination with firmwide learning resources
• Support compensation and bonus administration for local support staff by applying sound compensation principles and partnering with management on salary recommendations and related decisions
• Act as the primary HR liaison between the Tel Aviv office and U.S. headquarters, promoting consistency in communication, processes, training requirements, and talent services standards across jurisdictions
• Develop, implement, and continuously improve HR processes, procedures, and recordkeeping practices, maintaining accurate and compliant personnel, recruitment, and separation documentation and recommending policy or process enhancements where appropriate
• Supervise legal support staff to promote high-quality service, efficient workflow, and ongoing development, and assist with additional department activities and responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications

Skills & Competencies

• Ability to establish credibility with staff, attorneys

With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries.

As Papaya continues to scale globally, we are looking for an HR Business Partner to join our HRBP team, reporting to the Head of HRBP. In this role, you will work closely with managers and teams across the organization, supporting the execution of the people strategy and driving day-to-day organizational effectiveness.

You will partner with leaders at different levels, while working in close alignment with the Head of HRBP, HR Centers of Excellence, and People Operations, to ensure high-quality people decisions, strong management practices, and consistent employee experience.

Key Responsibilities:

• Partner with managers and team leads to support performance, execution, and team effectiveness
• Support the implementation of the people strategy within business units
• Coach managers on day-to-day people’s decisions, strengthening leadership quality and ensuring strong and consistent management practices
• Identify organizational challenges and support the implementation of practical, high-impact solutions
• Use data and insights to support decision-making and identify trends that impact teams and performance
• Provide ongoing support to employees, building trust and ensuring a high-quality employee experience
• Partner with HR Centers of Excellence to implement global frameworks (Talent, Reward, L&D), ensuring adoption and real business impact

Requirements:

• At least 5 years of experience as an HRBP in a fast-paced global environment
• Strong understanding of people processes (performance, talent, employee relations)
• Experience working closely with managers as a trusted advisor
• High ownership, accountability, strong consulting skills, and execution capabilities
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills
• Courage and confidence to challenge managers and provide honest, constructive feedback
• Hands-on, proactive, and solution-oriented approach
• Data-driven mindset and comfort working with HR systems and tools
• Tech-savvy, with experience working with digital tools and AI-based solutions

jobs.title: Learning & Development Partner
jobs.description:
This is us

Kaltura’s (NYSE:KLTR) mission is to power any video experience for any organization – live, on-demand, or real-time. We not only want to make using video simpler, but we also want to better people’s lives through video. Founded in 2006, Kaltura is now a global leader in the video market with millions of people using our products daily to teach, learn, watch, connect, and collaborate. Among our customers, you’ll find more than 1000 global, well-known organizations.

15+ years since starting the company, we continue to foster a diverse and collaborative work environment where everyone gets a say. Our team is currently 700+ people, and we’re still growing. We have offices in New York, London, Singapore, and Tel Aviv, but our technology is all in the cloud.

Kaltura has a fast-paced environment where initiative is always encouraged. Together with our hybrid work model and flexible state of mind, you get the right conditions for creative juices to flow freely. Thanks to our long line of products, cultivation of rich collaborative culture and care for each Kalturian, you’ll never run out of room to grow and evolve.

If you don't meet 100% of the requirements below - that's okay, nobody's perfect! We believe in hiring people, not just a list of skills. We encourage you to apply if you think this is a role that would make you excited about coming to work every day.

Requirements:

The Role

As a Learning & Development Partner at Kaltura, you will play a key role in strengthening employee capabilities and driving learning engagement across the organization. You will partner closely with HRBPs, managers, and global teams to identify critical skill gaps, design impactful learning experiences, and embed on a culture of continuous development.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative HR team and influence how learning is experienced, adopted, and measured across a global organization.

Reports to: Senior Director of OD and HRBP

The day-to-day:

• Partner with HRBPs and managers to diagnose skill gaps and translate business needs into targeted learning solutions
• Design and deliver engaging learning programs (workshops, blended learning, and digital content) that drive participation and behavior change
• Facilitate training sessions and team development activities for diverse, global audiences
• Lead L&D initiatives end-to-end, including planning, communication, stakeholder alignment, and execution
• Maintain and optimize digital learning platforms and content to improve accessibility and user experience
• Track learning effectiveness, engagement, and impact; use data and feedback to continuously improve programs

Ideally, we’re looking for:

• Bachelor's degree in human resources, Organizational Development, Instructional Design, Behavioral Sciences, or a related field
• 3–4 years of experience in developing and facilitating learning processes
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering with HR and business leaders
• Hands-on approach with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
• Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with experience working with global teams
• Data-driven mindset, with the ability to measure learning impact and iterate accordingly

These would also be nice:

• Experience working with LMS or digital learning platforms
• Background in organizational development, learning design, or behavioral methods
• Experience supporting global or cross-cultural teams

The perks:

• Hybrid, flexible work environment
• Extended private health (including mental) insurance
• Personal and professional development programs
• Occasional Cross company long weekends

jobs.title: Global HR SuccessFactors Systems Lead
jobs.description:
About The Role

We’re looking for a Global HR SuccessFactors Systems Analyst to strengthen, streamline, and future-proof our global HR technology landscape. This role focuses on building a solid, scalable, and agile architecture and infrastructure that supports ADAMA’s evolving business and HR transformation needs.

You will oversee the design, integrity, and continuous improvement of our global HR systems — ensuring they are stable, well-integrated, and aligned with the company’s digital strategy. Partnering closely with HR, IT, and other global functions, you’ll translate business needs into sustainable technology solutions that enhance efficiency and user experience.

This position reports to the Head of Global HR Systems & Analytics and has no direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee the global HR systems architecture, ensuring a coherent, scalable, and secure ecosystem all HR modules.
• Define and maintain design principles, data models, and integration standards that support agility and scalability.
• Manage system changes, testing, and releases, ensuring stability and continuous improvement.
• Drive simplification, standardization, and automation across processes and modules while respecting local needs.
• Lead integration and data governance, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with privacy standards.
• Monitor system performance and proactively identify enhancements and automation opportunities.
• Lead system and infrastructure projects end-to-end, ensuring alignment with the global HR technology roadmap.
• Act as a bridge between HR, IT, and vendors, translating business needs into practical technical solutions.
• Provide guidance and training to HR teams and key users, promoting digital enablement and best practices.

Qualifications

• Proven Experience in HR systems implementation and configuration, including objects, workflows and business rules, all HR modules.
• Strong IT background in system configuration and technical integrations.
• Deep understanding of enterprise HR platforms (e.g., SuccessFactors) and their role within a global systems landscape.
• Proven experience in managing and evolving HR technology and architecture within large, complex, multinational organizations.

Voca CIC is AudioCodes’ flagship, award-winning Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) portfolio, designed to meet organizations where they are today and where they’re going next. The portfolio covers two distinct opportunities: a Microsoft Teams-native contact center for organizations standardized on the Microsoft ecosystem, and a voice-platform-agnostic AI Receptionist that runs on top of any phone system.

It is AI-first by design, embedding Conversational AI and Generative AI into the agent and customer journey through AI voice agents, AI call summarization, and sentiment analysis, alongside an omnichannel toolkit that unifies voice, chat, and email into a single agent screen. The Voca AI Receptionist is our standalone, entry-level AI offering for businesses of all sizes, from SMB to large enterprise. Built as a multi-platform solution that sits on top of any voice platform (Microsoft Teams, Cisco, Avaya, RingCentral, traditional PBX, or carrier voice services), it dramatically expands our addressable market well beyond the Microsoft footprint. It delivers AI-driven call routing, document and website-grounded Q&A, CRM integration, appointment scheduling, and outbound SMS to organizations looking for a fast on-ramp into AI-powered customer service, regardless of the phone system they already own.

• Deliver remote instructor-led training sessions, for customers, channel partners and resellers, and internal teams including Professional Services, Support, and Sales Engineers.
• Build and maintain hands-on lab environments and practical exercises that simulate real-world Voca CIC deployments and AI-driven contact center scenarios
