jobs.title: People Infrastructure Lead (Systems, Data & Compensation)
jobs.description:
Description

Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters. With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities — including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. We're in a period of significant growth. There's an enormous amount to build, improve, and shape - and every hire changes the trajectory of the company.

What This Role Is

Think of this as the platform engineering role for our People function. Just like a platform team builds the systems that let engineers ship fast - you'll build the operational layer that lets the entire company run fast.

Real-time data. Automated workflows. Compensation logic that actually scales. No legacy systems to untangle, no inherited processes to maintain. Full ownership over how People infrastructure gets designed, built, and operated at Upwind.

This isn't traditional People Ops. It's the technical backbone behind it.

What You'll Build

• Own the People infrastructure end-to-end - HiBob and the integrated ecosystem around it.
• Engineer frictionless, automated lifecycle workflows across the entire employee journey - from offer to offboarding.
• Build the compensation infrastructure from the ground up: leveling, salary bands, benchmarking, and the logic that ties them together.
• Turn organizational data into a real-time, high-fidelity source of truth that leaders actually trust.
• Deploy AI and automation to eliminate manual work — not assist it.
• Give leadership the visibility and operational agility to make fast, confident decisions at any scale.

These are the core domains. What you build within them and how - is largely up to you.

You'll thrive here if

• You've built People systems from scratch - not maintained someone else's.
• You think in systems and data, not tickets and tasks.
• You're technically comfortable - you can turn a People challenge into an automated workflow without waiting for IT.
• Compensation logic excites you, not intimidates you.
• You've worked in a high-growth environment and know exactly what breaks at scale.
• You're excited by using AI to replace manual work - not just dress it up.
• You move decisions forward instead of getting stuck in discussions.

Requirements

• Experience building or operating scalable People systems in high-growth tech environments.

• Hands-on with HiBob (or equivalent HRIS) and the automation layer around it (n8n, Zapier, LLMs, or similar).
• Strong grasp of organizational structure, compensation frameworks, and what it takes to scale them.
• Fluent in English - this is a global, cross-functional role.

This is about building teams, influencing decisions, and making Qodo win.

Our Team’s Values And How We Work

• One team. Clear ownership, zero silos
• High standards. We care about quality and speed
• No ego. We challenge each other to get better
• Mission-driven. We do what it takes to make Qodo win

What You’ll Do

• Own full-cycle recruiting across Engineering, Product, and GTM roles - from building pipelines across channels, through interviews, to closing
• Partner closely with hiring managers to deeply understand needs (technical + cultural), shape roles, and guide hiring decisions
• Work hand-in-hand with the Talent Acquisition Coordinator to run efficient, high-quality processes
• Create exceptional candidate experiences - fast, sharp, human
• Track and analyze pipeline data to continuously improve how we hire
• Contribute beyond recruiting: employer branding, People initiatives, and anything else that moves the needle

Requirements:

Who You Are

• 5+ years of technical recruiting experience (startup / high-growth environment preferred), with a strong understanding of recruitment best practices and current trends
• A team player with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, who shows up for others while holding a high bar
• You take ownership end-to-end, bring a marathon mindset (not literally, we’re not runners either), and know how to push things forward and get things done
• You’re comfortable working with different tools and leveraging AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) to build smarter, more efficient processes
• Fluent in English, with the ability to conduct interviews in English
• Hands-on experience with Spark Hire and HiBob

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
Gini Apps is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will play a critical role in identifying, attracting and recruiting top technical talent to help us achieve our ambitious goals. You will work closely with hiring managers and clients to understand their needs and deliver exceptional candidates who align with the company’s culture and values. Your expertise in the technology landscape will be critical in identifying and connecting with potential candidates, ensuring an efficient and effective recruitment process.

Responsibilities:

• Sourcing and identifying potential candidates through various channels, including job boards, social media and networking events.
• Conducting detailed interviews to assess candidates’ technical skills, experience and cultural fit with the company’s clients.
• Managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from job posting, interviews to job offer negotiation and onboarding.
• Collaborate with hiring managers to understand their workforce needs and develop effective recruiting strategies.
• Maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future recruiting needs.
• Utilize recruiting metrics to analyze and improve the recruiting process.

Requirements:

• Minimum 1 year of experience in technical recruiting.
• In-depth understanding of various technical roles and the software development lifecycle.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build relationships with candidates and hiring managers.
• Experience working with customers.
• Experience working with social networks, especially LinkedIn.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
• Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team.

jobs.title: R&D Recruiter
jobs.description:
ScaleOps, the leader in real-time automated cloud resource management, is revolutionizing how DevOps teams manage their cloud-native application infrastructures. Backed by venture capital and software industry titans, ScaleOps’ platform removes the organizational friction between application owners and DevOps teams by fully automating the resource management process to meet real-time demand.

The ScaleOps platform dynamically manages the application’s resource allocation, eliminating the need for manual intervention. The result is improved application performance, 60%- 80% cloud cost savings, and a fully automated allocation process.

With well over $80 million in backing, ScaleOps has seen tremendous business growth, attracting global industry leaders to its customer base. ScaleOps automatically manages the production environments of over 50 enterprises, including Wiz, CATO Networks, Outreach, SentinelOne, Maxar, Playtika, Orca Security, EQ Bank, Outbrain, PayU, and Noname.

We are seeking an experienced R&D Recruiter preferably with a background in startups company. The Talent Acquisition Partner will be responsible for managing the hiring process, from sourcing candidates to managing the interview process, with a strong focus on creating an exceptional candidate experience.

What You Will Be Doing:

• Manage the full recruitment life cycle, including planning and executing creative and targeted recruitment strategies.
• Source candidates through social media, job boards, and internal databases.
• Conduct interviews and managing the interview process from start to finish.
• Work closely with department heads to understand role requirements and support hiring decisions.
• Build relationships with candidates and maintain regular follow-up throughout the hiring process.
• Utilize and maintain up-to-date candidate data in Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

Requirements:

What You Bring Along:

• Min 3 years of experience in recruitment, preferably in a startup environment.
• Familiarity with fast-paced hiring processes and the ability to thrive in a dynamic environment.
• Strong multitasking skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent communication skills in both English and Hebrew, both written and verbal.
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively, with a proactive and initiative-driven approach.
• Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) is a plus.
